lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Shannon Wang is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Shannon is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d41: 🕯️ Shannon Wang is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Shannon kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Shannon's gone." Francesca looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Shannon." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Christian blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Fine Woodworking (Level 1). Joints that hold without nails: mortise, tenon, and the humble dovetail.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Repair & Mending (Level 1). Look at what's broken before you touch it: find the failure point, not the symptom. Most breaks are one small thing.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Shannon Wang, 41 days. The mantle passes to Christian Nair.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Christian Nair, 46 — a carpenter. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Green Whisper, Berserker Rage.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Shannon — and Shannon is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Francesca, Rahul, Lucie and 3 more speak for Christian — "Shannon trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Christian before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
